usageNotes: Use this to register a new ACME account with a certificate authority (e.g. Let's Encrypt) so PDM can automate TLS certificate issuance. The operation is asynchronous — it returns a UPID that must be polled for completion. If the CA requires External Account Binding (EAB), supply both eab_kid and eab_hmac_key together; omitting either will cause registration to fail.

examples.summary: Register a Let's Encrypt production account named 'letsencrypt'

tips: Omit 'name' to register the account as the default (name defaults to 'default').
Use the Let's Encrypt staging directory (https://acme-staging-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory) for testing to avoid rate limits.
Setting 'tos_url' is how PDM records your acceptance of the CA's Terms of Service — required by most CAs.
Poll the returned UPID via the task log endpoints to confirm successful registration before attempting certificate orders.
